component.name: Elite Podcasts
component.summary: Discover, follow, and listen to podcasts

description.p: Find shows through search, charts, and categories, then follow them to keep their latest episodes together. Stream or download episodes, save favorites, and pick up where you left off.
Elite Podcasts uses a native GNOME interface with playback speed controls, an episode queue, listening history, and desktop media controls. Import or export subscriptions with OPML.
